name: device-reconciler-platform
description: The operational half of a two-channel, two-clock desired-state reconciler for energy devices: durable in-flight state, idempotent dispatch, per-vendor backpressure and observability, against a runnable mock aggregator platform. Everything runs locally.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run fmt:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:core && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.hono:up: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.hono.yaml up -d --wait && npm run hono:provision
scripts.hono:edge: npm run hono:provision && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.hono.yaml --profile edge up -d --build --wait
scripts.hono:down: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.hono.yaml --profile edge down
